types.title: Transfer Requested
types.description: A transfer was asked for: a REFER arrived, or the REST API was called. Sent to the transfer's webhook and event sockets at the same moment.

fields.name: event
fields.description: The event name: the type's last segment.

fields.name: time
fields.description: When it happened, ISO-8601 in UTC.

fields.name: sessionKeys
fields.description: The call's session keys as the session selectors compute them from its first INVITE: what a REST request names as sessionKey.

fields.name: uid
fields.description: The REST request's notification.uid, so a client can match events to its request.

fields.name: style
fields.description: The REST request's transfer style: blind, attended, conference or refer. Absent for a REFER's transfer.

fields.name: referTo
fields.description: The transfer target's URI.

fields.name: method
fields.description: The SIP method of the message behind the event.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The SIP status, when a response is behind the event.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The SIP reason phrase, when a response is behind the event.

fields.name: request
fields.description: The REST request that started the transfer, as it was sent. Absent for a REFER's transfer.
